title: AI 视频包

editor_note.text: 从生成到成片:ai-video-generation 和 kling-3-0 负责生素材,video-edit 剪辑,remotion-render 用代码渲染出最终视频。八个包里最新潮、也最烧算力的一套,生成类的两件需要对应平台的 key。做产品短片、社交物料可以试。预期管理:AI 素材挑三条能用一条,就算高产。
editor_note.author: 主理人
editor_note.text_en: From generation to final cut: ai-video-generation and kling-3-0 produce the material, video-edit cuts it, remotion-render renders the final video with code. The trendiest and most compute-hungry set here; the two generation skills need keys for their platforms. Worth trying for product shorts and social assets. Expectation management: if one out of three generated clips is usable, that's a good day.

tagline_en: Generate, edit, render — end to end
